extension.name: RSB Events (Google Calendar)
extension.author: Raydraws, L.L.C.
extension.description: Shows upcoming events from a public Google Calendar (iCal) feed. Keeps the last good copy if the feed can't be reached, and shows nothing when there are no upcoming events.

field.name: ics_url
field.label: Public iCal address
field.description: Google Calendar: Settings for the calendar, Integrate calendar, Public address in iCal format. Never use the secret address.
